description: This file provides Polish (pl-PL) culture information for the DateJS library, including date and time formats, month and day names, regex patterns for parsing dates, and various date manipulation functions.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds to zero for a Date object.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the time portion of the Date object to the current time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares the Date object to another date, returning -1, 0, or 1.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day of the week given its name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month given its name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specific month of a specific year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the timezone name for a given offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the timezone offset for a given timezone name.
